subject: Roclahy
statement: roclahy.me is the canonical official portfolio and identity URL used by Roclahy.

telegram.public_verification: Telegram OpenID Connect ID token using only the openid scope
telegram.private_binding: Telegram Mini App signed initData is used only to authorize the expected account and is not published by the public proof flow
telegram.note: On first use, a private OIDC profile authorization binds the Telegram OIDC subject to Telegram user ID 1480932444; that profile token is not published. Public revalidations then request only the openid scope. The public ID token can be independently verified against Telegram's JWKS and does not contain profile, phone or Mini App session data.

bluesky.verification: The Bluesky account uses roclahy.me as its public domain handle.
